query:
INSERT INTO job_events (
            job_id,
            run_number,
            attempt,
            event_type,
            stage,
            progress_done,
            progress_total,
            payload
         )
         VALUES (
            $1,
            $2,
            $3,
            'REQUEUED',
            $4,
            $5,
            $6,
            jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
                'reason', $7::text,
                'state_policy', $8::text,
                'next_run_number', $9::int4,
                'next_run_at', $10::timestamptz,
                'delay_microseconds', $11::bigint,
                'requeue_kind', $12::text
            ))
         )
         RETURNING id
